title: The society sim as a living miniature

brief.prompt: My society simulation (~/Documents/github/society) as a living miniature village: seven places in a ring around the parish commons, in the observer window's clockwise order (granary at the top, market, well, hut, shrine, woods, field), connected by a ring path. Twelve villagers walk between the places following the moves recorded in the sim's journal, one recorded turn per second, each with a small gem over the head colored by the motive behind the action (fear, duty, hunger, thirst, kinship, promise). Late afternoon turns into a lantern-lit dusk while the camera cranes down from a high oblique view, tilt-shift like a model village.

inputs.note: The sim's observer window: seven places in a ring around the commons, villagers as colored dots.
24 recorded turns: turn, day, agent, place after the action, action, motive.

elements: a ring of small village buildings around a central plaza
a large tree on a round plaza
small figures standing or walking around the village
